Module net.automatalib.core
Package net.automatalib.graph.impl

Class SimpleMapGraph<N>

java.lang.Object
net.automatalib.graph.impl.SimpleMapGraph<N>
Type Parameters:
N - node type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<N>, FiniteRepresentation, Graph<N,N>, IndefiniteGraph<N,N>, IndefiniteSimpleGraph<N>, MutableGraph<N,N,N,Void>, SimpleGraph<N>, UniversalGraph<N,N,N,Void>, UniversalIndefiniteGraph<N,N,N,Void>
public class SimpleMapGraph<@Nullable N> extends Object implements MutableGraph<N,N,N,Void>
A very simple graph realization, where nodes can be arbitrary Java objects. This graph does not support edge properties.

This class provides maximum flexibility, but should only be used if performance is not a major concern.
